s: November 7, 2017 - Got it. It had something to do with trying to restore from my backup. A friend who set up as a new device and did not restore from backup didn’t have this issue. I went into settings, went into my iCloud account and went to backup. There it let me stop the restore I had in progress, which of course means some things might not finish transferring over, and allowed me to manually backup my new phone.
